what: Hovering a list turns on a glass band (white 15% + blur 16px, rounded .5rem) behind that row, in place over .3s expo, and it slides to the center of the new row over .35s expo when you move to another row. Leaving the list turns it off over .15s power1. A trailing text like ”Read” or an arrow can be placed at the band’s right end.

options.[data-fx-part=row]: Row the band follows (li if none)
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: (if present) uses that element as the band — otherwise creates an empty band
options.[data-fx-part=skip]: Reach that line and the band is drawn (a line that can’t be pressed)
